content: W3C IndexedDB 2.0 规范第 2.4 节 Keys 明确规定：A key has an associated type which is one of: number, date, string, binary, or array. The following ECMAScript types are valid keys: Number primitive values (except NaN), Date objects (except NaN), String primitive values, ArrayBuffer / TypedArray objects, Array objects. Attempting to convert other ECMAScript values (including Boolean) to a key will fail.
